binary.git_head_subject: Make search ranking and context assembly deterministic
binary.note: ~/.local/bin/cogz identical via rename-replace. Supersedes sha 5f4bc3ba (pre-determinism-fix build).

rules: All benchmark invocations use the pinned binary path, never PATH lookup
No cogz rebuilds mid-campaign; if the binary changes, record a new manifest and flag prior results
Never `cogz reset` a benchmark corpus; snapshot cogz.db files instead
notes: Snapshot restore protocol: never cp a snapshot over a live DB file. On 2026-09-22 a plain cp restore over .cogz/cogz.db with open WAL connections corrupted the DB (malformed image). Correct procedure: copy snapshot to a new name, rm -f the -wal/-shm files, then mv (atomic rename) into place. Capturing a snapshot via plain cp is safe (yields last-checkpoint state).
